security_audit.summary: Most external command findings are Markdown backticks or TypeScript examples, not executable shell calls. The skill still references DATABASE_URL and suggests Drizzle migration commands that can use credentials and change a database schema. No prompt injection or malicious data-exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.issue: Database credentials are referenced through DATABASE_URL.
remediation.suggestion: Document that DATABASE_URL must use least privilege and must never appear in prompts, logs, or shared transcripts.

remediation.issue: Drizzle migration commands can alter a live database schema.
remediation.suggestion: Require human confirmation before drizzle-kit push and recommend backups plus review of generated migrations.

content.user_title: Manage Neon Postgres With Drizzle ORM
content.value_statement: Database setup can be hard to trace across connection, schema, and migration files. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise guidance for Neon Postgres and Drizzle ORM work.
actual_capabilities: Describes the Neon serverless Postgres and Drizzle ORM stack used by the project.
Shows where the database connection and schema files are expected to live.
Provides TypeScript examples for selecting and inserting records with Drizzle.
Lists auth and application tables documented by the skill.
Documents Drizzle Kit commands for generating and pushing migrations.
limitations: Does not include complete schema definitions or migration files.
Does not validate database credentials or connection access.
Does not provide transaction, indexing, or rollback guidance.
May require project-specific adjustments before code changes are applied.

use_cases.title: Set up Neon connections
use_cases.description: Align database initialization with Neon serverless Postgres and the Drizzle HTTP adapter.

use_cases.title: Review schema ownership
use_cases.description: Understand which tables support auth data and which tables support application features.

use_cases.title: Plan migration work
use_cases.description: Prepare Drizzle Kit generation and push steps before changing a database schema.

prompt_templates.title: Explain the database setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain how this project connects to Neon Postgres with Drizzle ORM. Include where the connection and schema files are located.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a new table
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a new Drizzle table for [feature]. Include columns, relationships, and migration steps.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a query flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this database query flow for Drizzle ORM. Identify schema assumptions, indexes, and transaction concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a migration rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a migration rollout checklist for this Drizzle change. Cover generate, review, backup, push, and rollback decisions.

output_examples.output: A short map of the Neon connection, Drizzle adapter, schema file, and query examples.

output_examples.input: Plan a migration for a new table.

output_examples.output: A focused review covering filters, table imports, index needs, and data consistency risks.

best_practices: Use least privilege database credentials for local and automated workflows.
Review generated migrations before applying them to shared environments.
Keep schema changes, query updates, and tests in the same review.
anti_patterns: Running migration pushes against production without backup or approval.
Sharing DATABASE_URL values in prompts, tickets, logs, or screenshots.
Changing schema files without checking affected queries and auth tables.

faq.question: What database stack does this skill describe?
faq.answer: It describes Neon serverless Postgres with Drizzle ORM and the Neon HTTP adapter.

faq.question: Can it create a complete schema for my project?
faq.answer: It can help plan schema work, but the skill does not include complete schema definitions.

faq.question: Does it need access to DATABASE_URL?
faq.answer: The documented connection uses DATABASE_URL, but secrets should stay outside prompts and logs.

faq.question: Can it run database migrations safely?
faq.answer: It documents Drizzle Kit commands, but migration pushes need human review, backups, and environment checks.

faq.question: Is this useful with Claude Code and Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. It gives Claude, Claude Code, and Codex project context for database and ORM tasks.

faq.question: What should I verify before applying changes?
faq.answer: Verify schema intent, migration output, credentials, target environment, and rollback options.
